library.name: Three.js
library.description: WebXR / WebGL 3D library used to render the cyberspace scene.

library.name: Three.js addons (GLTFLoader, Draco, KTX2, meshopt, FBXLoader)
library.description: Three.js example modules and their decoders: the glTF loader with Draco, KTX2/Basis and meshopt support, plus the FBX loader (with its fflate and NURBS dependencies), used to load authored 3D asset packs in glTF or FBX form.

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (hand/face landmarkers + models)
library.description: On-device hand and face landmark detection (WASM runtime, ES module bundle and the hand/face landmarker model files) powering the optional pose-based camera navigation for flat-screen viewers.
